senses.gloss: भार्या- + अर्थिन् भार्या- + अर्थिन्, adj. desiring a wife, Chr. 6, 5.
भर्तृ- + दारक भर्तृ- + दारक, 1. m. a young prince, designated as suścessor. 2. f. का, a princess.

भर भर, i. e. भृ + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A load, Lass. 88, 2; Vikr. d. 42; 52; with भुवस्, ἄχθος ἀρούρας i. e. a dead mass.
 2. With कृ, To make a load, to support one's self, Hit. 47, 3.
 3. Plenty, Śiś. 9, 47.
 4. Much, excessive, Bhartṛ. 2, 68.
 5. A measure of value of two thousand Palas.
 II. adj. Who or what supports.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. -fer; A.S. -bora.

भार भार, i. e. भृ + अ, m.
 1. Carrying burthens, Pañc. i. d. 312.
 2. Weight, a burthen, Pañc. 52, 4; figurat., Pañc. 31, 3 (of government); v. d. 4.
 3. A great weight, Pañc. 99, 25.
 4. A weight of gold equal to two thousand Palas.
 5. A yoke.
 --Comp.
भरट भरट, m. A potter.

भरण भरण, i. e. भृ + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Bearing, Pañc. 257, 23; supporting, Śāk. d. 192.
 2. Nourishing, Hit. ii. d. 42.
 3. Wages, hire.
 II. f. णी.
 1. The name of the second lunar asterism.
 2. A creeper, commonly Ghoshā.
भरण्ड भरण्ड (vb. भ्रि). m. A master, a lord.
भारण्ड भारण्ड, भारुण्ड भारुण्ड, भेरण्ड भेरण्ड (m.), The name of a fabulous bird, see Pañc. 263, 19; cf. my translation, 535, n. 1437. f. दी, Its female, Pañc. 264, 4.
भरण्य भरण्य (for भरणीय, ptcple. of the fut. pass. of भृ), n. Wages, hire.

भरत भरत, i. e. भरन्त्, ptcple. pres. of भृ, + अ (cf. Śāk. d. 192), m.
 1. The name of several princes, and of a sage, the inventor of dramatic composition, Vikr. d. 36; Utt. Rāmac. 111, 4.
 2. pl. The descendants of Bharata, Chr. 3, 1.
 3. An actor, a mime.

भारत भारत, i. e. भरत + अ,
 I. patronym. A descendant of Bharata, Hit. iv. d. 86.
 II. m.
 1. An actor.
 2. A name of fire.
 III. f. ती.
 1. Speech, Chr. 53, 1.
 2. Dramatic recitation.
 3. The goddess of speech, Pañc. ii. d. 16.
 4. A quail.
 IV. n.
 1. India proper.
 2. A great epic poem, also महाभारत महा-, n.
भरथ भरथ, m. A deity presiding over one of the regions.
भरद्वाज भरद्वाज, i. e. भरन्त्, ptcple. pres. of भृ, -वाज, m. The name of a Muni, Johns. Sel. 1, 1.

भारद्वाज भारद्वाज, i. e. भरद्वाज + अ,
 I. patronym., m.
 1. Epithet of [] Droṇa.
 2. One of the seven Ṛṣis.
 3. Agastya.
 4. The son of Vṛhaspati.
 II. m. A skylark, Pañc. 157, 3, Wild cotton.
 IV. n. A bone.
भरित भरित, i. e. भर + इत, adj. Filled, MBh. 2, 2061.
भरिमन् or भरीमन् भरी̆मन् (vb. भृ, or भर, + इमन्), m. A household, a family.

भरु भरु, i. e. भृ + उ, m.
 1. Gold.
 2. A lord.
 3. Śiva.
 4. Viṣṇu.
भरुज भरु-ज, m. A small sort of jackal.
भरुटक भरुटक (vb. भृ), n. Fried meat.
भर्ग भर्ग, i. e. भ्राज्, or भृज्, + अ, m. Śiva.

भर्गस् भर्गस्, i. e. भ्राज्, or भृज्, + अस्, n.
 1. Light, Lass. 99, 11 = Rigv. iii. 62, 10.
 2. A name of Brahman.
 --Cf. A.S. baelch, superbia.

भर्तृ भर्तृ, i. e. भृ + तृ,
 I. m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. One who contains, Śiś. 9, 17.
 2. A cherisher, Bhag. 9, 18.
 3. A protector.
 II. m.
 1. A lord, Vikr. d. 36; master, d. 155.
 2. A commander, Man. 7, 94.
 3. A husband, Hit. i. d. 196, M.M.
 --Comp.

ऽभर्तृक -भर्तृ + क, latter part of comp. words, which are, or were originally adj.; e. g. प्रोषित- (ptcple. of the pf. pass. of प्र-वस्), f. का, A woman whose husband is absent, Ṛt. 6, 9. स-, f. का, A woman whose husband is alive.
भर्तृघ्नत्व भर्तृ-घ्न + त्व, n. Injuring one's master, MBh. 2, 2123.
भर्तृत्व भर्तृ + त्व, n. Husbandship, Kathās. 26, 148.
भर्तृमन्त् भर्तृ + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Married, Śāk. d. 114.
भर्तृहरि भर्तृ-हरि, m. The name of a prince and poet.

भर्त्स् भर्त्स्, i. 10, Ātm. (also Par.).
 1. To menace, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 14.
 2. To blame, to abuse, MBh. 4, 357.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भर्त्सित, Blamed, Pañc. i. d. 170. n. Menace, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 21.
 --With the prep. [] अभि अभि, To menace, Rām. 1, 28, 13. अभिभर्त्सित, Terrified, MBh. 3, 10921.
 --With अव अव, To deter, Chr. 26, 66 (read ˚भर्त्स्-अयत्).
 --With नि नि, To menace, Pañc. 220, 2 (probably corr. निर्भ्˚).
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To menace, Pañc. 84, 18; MBh. 1, 4190.
 2. To blame, Utt. Rāmac. 174, 6; Chr. 60, 32.
 3. To abuse, Hit. 64, 22.
 --With अभि-निस् अभि-निस्, To blame, Rām. 2, 78, 19.
 --With परि परि, To menace, MBh. 3, 16008.
 --With सम् सम्, To reproach, to blame, Rām. 2, 75, 16.

भर्त्सन भर्त्स् + अन, n.
 1. Threat.
 2. Reproach, curse.
भर्ब् भर्ब्, भर्भ् भर्भ्, see भर्व्.

भर्मन् भर्मन्, i. e. भृ + मन्, n.
 1. Wages, hire.
 2. Gold.
 3. A coin, a piece of money.
 4. The navel.
 --Comp.

भर्व् भर्व्, and † भर्भ् भर्भ्, or † भर्ब् भर्ब्, i. 1, Far.
 1. To injure (ved.).
 2. † To eat.
 --With the second signification and the form भर्ब् cf. ϕέρβω, ϕορβή; Lat. herba; with the first and भर्व् Goth. balvjan.
भारक भार + क, m. A load, Man. 11, 133.
भारव भारव, n. A bowstring.
भारवि भारवि, m. The name of a poet, Chr. 170, 1.
भारि भारि, m. A lion.
भारिक भारिक, i. e. भार + इक, m. A porter, Rājat. 5, 204 (treasurer; cf. 176 and my Chr. p. 315, n. ad 176. I propose to read भौरिक).
भारिन् भारिन्, i. e. भार + इन्, m. A porter, Man. 2, 138; Kathās. 22, 96.
भारुण्ड भारुण्ड, see भारण्ड.

भार्गव भार्गव, i. e. भृगु + अ, patronym.
 I. m.
 1. A descendant of Bhṛgu.
 2. Epithet of Paraśurāma, Johns. Sel. 4, 22; Utt. Rāmac. 13, 10.
 3. A name of Śukra, regent of Venus.
 4. An archer.
 5. An elephant.
 6. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 60, 189.
 II. f. वी.
 1. Pārvatī.
 2. Lakṣmī.
 3. Bent grass, Panicum dactylon.

भार्या भार्या, properly ptcple. fut. pass. of भृ, f. A wife, Pañc. 137, 9.
 --Comp.
भार्याट भार्याट, m. A man who lets out his wife for prostitution.
भार्यात्व भार्या + त्व, f. State of a female, Man. 12, 69.
भार- + यष्टि भार- + यष्टि, f. a yoke or pole for carrying burthens.
भार- + वाह भार- + वाह, m. a porter.

भार- + वाहिक भार- + वाहिक,
 I. adj. carrying burthens.
 II. m. a porter.
कुरु-, भरत-, भृगु- + श्रेष्ठ कुरु-, भरत-, भृगु- + श्रेष्ठ, m. an excellent descendant of Kuru, Bharata, Bhṛgu, Chr. 17, 32; 41, 6; 26, 74.
